name: Passenger Sentiment Team
description: A small sequential team that routes the passenger message, checks sentiment, retrieves the relevant airport facts, and composes the final reply.

members.when: After identifying the main passenger intent and the likely entity to resolve.
After determining the passenger's emotional tone and urgency.
After locating the matching airport service, terminal, zone, policy, and reference.
After receiving the intent, sentiment guidance, and verified service facts.
